framing: Si je suis chef en plein rush, qu'est-ce que la caisse devrait me dire/donner que NF FoodKing V1 POS ne livre PAS aujourd'hui ?

functionality_mapped: Vente directe — cart + payment via PaymentComponent
Encaisser commande borne — kiosk-cash panel + PosCounterCollectModal SSOT
V5 split-tranche — PaymentComponent flow (FROZEN), counter-collect single-tender only (V1.0.2 deferred for multi-tranche on borne)
Refund — RefundWithCounterEntryService backend, ReceiptRemboursementMarker visible on receipts
Cash drawer — PosCashDrawerSessionDialog (fond / mouvements / cloture), no-sale drawer-open
Parked orders (substitute pause) — park CTA + ParkedOrdersComponent
Tracker / shortcuts — Prêt à livrer (PREPARED) + À encaisser borne panels on main page (Wave X X2)
Loyalty redeem CTA in operator bar

gaps.title: Cart line lacks chef-instruction input (POS direct sale)
gaps.chef_question: Si le client dit 'sans oignons / bien cuit / cuisson saignant', le caissier a-t-il un moyen de le transmettre au chef ?
gaps.evidence: OrderItem.instruction column EXISTS in DB (app/Models/OrderItem.php:79 fillable, RefundWithCounterEntryService.php:153 prefixes 'RTN:'). Kiosk cash detail view RENDERS item.instruction (PosComponent.vue:1230-1232). But the POS direct-sale cart (pos-v5-cart-item lines 763-859) has NO instruction input UI per line — only edit-via-wizard. The wizard popup writes composition, not free-text instructions. Backend payload at L3628 reads `instruction: row.instruction || ''` from cart row — that key has no setter in the cart UI.
gaps.scope: POS direct sale → KDS instruction propagation
gaps.fix_sketch: Add per-line note icon-button on each .pos-v5-cart-item that opens a quick textarea modal (max 80 chars, like the existing kiosk wizard `customizeWithText`); write to cart row `instruction` field already wired backend-side.

gaps.title: No urgency / rush-priority flag on order
gaps.chef_question: Le chef peut-il voir 'cette commande est urgente, sert d'abord' ? Le caissier peut-il pre-marquer ?
gaps.evidence: Zero hits on grep `priority|rush|urgent|expedite|is_rush|priority_level` in PosComponent.vue, OrderItem.php, Order.php, migrations/. No column, no UI, no broadcast field. Operator bar exposes loyalty + cash session + tracker but no 'mark urgent' affordance. KDS receives orders in creation-order only.
gaps.fix_sketch: Add `orders.priority` enum column (normal | rush) + small icon button next to encaisser CTA; KDS subscribes and sorts/highlights rush tickets at top with red border.
gaps.frozen_zone_risk: medium — migration touches Order schema (NF525-adjacent table, append-only column is safe)

gaps.title: Allergen observation at counter — no capture path
gaps.chef_question: Le client dit 'je suis allergique aux arachides' au comptoir. Le caissier observe une réaction. Caisse signale au chef ?
gaps.evidence: PosComponent.vue:1234-1236 displays `item.allergens_snapshot` ONLY in the kiosk-cash panel detail view (read-only echo of what the kiosk customer declared). Direct-sale cart has NO allergen field. No 'allergie observée' UI. No order-level customer_allergens column in Order.php.
gaps.scope: POS direct sale → KDS allergen warning banner
gaps.fix_sketch: Add `orders.customer_allergens` JSON column + an 'Allergies déclarées' chip with 8-12 common allergens (gluten, lactose, fruits à coque, arachides, œufs, soja, poisson, crustacés, sésame) in cart header; broadcast in KDS ticket header with red banner.
gaps.frozen_zone_risk: low (new column, new chip UI, no PaymentComponent touch)

gaps.title: No stock-critical alert TO chef from caisse
gaps.chef_question: Le caissier voit qu'un produit va manquer (ex: dernier paquet de buns). Caisse pre-alert chef avant rupture ?
gaps.evidence: PosComponent.vue:51-71 has `pos-availability-banner` for ruptures already broadcast from backend, and ItemComponent.vue:31 shows `pos.item_86_d` overlay. BUT it's UNI-DIRECTIONAL (backend → cashier). No 'signaler stock critique' button in cart or item tile. No mechanism for cashier (who sees the physical stock when staff says 'plus que 3') to broadcast a heads-up to chef before the auto-86 trigger fires.
gaps.fix_sketch: Add a discreet 'Stock critique observé' button on rupture banner OR per-item card; emit a websocket event that KDS displays as 'Caissier signale 2-3 unités restantes sur {item}' for 5 minutes. No DB column needed if ephemeral.

gaps.title: Livreur coordination absent in POS
gaps.chef_question: Une commande livraison vient d'être encaissée. Quand le livreur arrive, le caissier saura-t-il l'orienter ? Le chef peut-il dire 'la commande de livreur X est prête' ?
gaps.evidence: Zero hits on `delivery_boy|DeliveryBoy|livreur|courier` in PosComponent.vue (the file imports nothing about delivery dispatch). Order type radiogroup has a 'Livraison' segment with inline address form (lines 656-738), but no UI to: (a) see which livreur is assigned, (b) assign one inline, (c) call/contact them, (d) see who's online/free. Tracker shortcut PREPARED panel says 'Livré' button but there is no row indicating 'En attente livreur' state.
gaps.fix_sketch: Add a 'Livreurs en service' compact strip below 'Prêt à livrer' panel showing online livreurs with active-orders count + quick assign on PREPARED kiosk/delivery tickets; data already exists via DeliveryBoyCashSession.

gaps.title: No pause-screen / assistance-client mode
gaps.chef_question: Le caissier doit aider un client en salle (5-10 min). Peut-il verrouiller la caisse sans perdre le panier ?
gaps.evidence: Park-order CTA exists (PosComponent.vue:553-561) which is a workaround (save & resume), but: (a) it commits to a Pos parked-order record — overkill for 'je reviens dans 2 min', (b) screen stays unlocked (next staff/customer can see cart + customer name + total), (c) no PIN/lock screen. Search grep `lock_screen|pause|verrouill|hold.*screen` returned 0 hits.
gaps.fix_sketch: Add a 'Mode assistance' toggle in operator bar that overlays a soft lock-screen (PIN to dismiss, cart preserved in memory); separate from park-order which persists DB-side.

gaps.title: No prep-time estimate visible to cashier
gaps.chef_question: Le client demande 'combien de temps ?' au comptoir. Le caissier doit deviner. Aucun signal de la cuisine.
gaps.evidence: PosComponent.vue uses `activeOrdersStats.ready / active` for badge tone but no estimate (mean prep time, current queue depth in minutes, current cuisine throughput). Greps for `prep_time|preparation_time|estimate|delay|delai|temps_prep` in PosComponent.vue all returned 0 hits.
gaps.fix_sketch: Backend KDS service emits a rolling 5-min mean preparation time per category; POS operator bar adds a small chip 'Cuisine: ~8 min' (auto-updated) for cashier to quote customers.

gaps.title: No quick recall (re-fire) for chef-side complaint
gaps.chef_question: Chef envoie un plat brûlé / mauvais → caissier doit refaire vite. Caisse a-t-elle un 'recall + refire' rapide ?
gaps.evidence: Refund path exists (RefundWithCounterEntryService) and prefixes new item with 'RTN: ' prefix in instruction. But that's a fiscal refund (NF525 chained). No 'recall this item, send it again to KDS as priority' shortcut. The cashier today must (a) refund the line, (b) re-add it to a new order, (c) hope KDS picks it up — no 'this is a recook' tag for chef.
gaps.fix_sketch: On any line of a PAID order in PosOrderShowComponent, add 'Refaire (cuisine)' action that creates a zero-price companion line on a NEW order with `is_recook=true` flag visible in KDS; no refund needed if comp is owner-approved (separate authz gate).
gaps.frozen_zone_risk: medium — touches OrderItem schema (additive column safe) and KDS dispatch

gaps.title: Customer-message field at order header level absent
gaps.chef_question: Le client dit 'C'est pour Marie, joyeux anniversaire'. Cashier note ?
gaps.evidence: Per-line `instruction` exists DB-side (see G-01) but NO order-level customer message column. Order.php has no `customer_message|note|comment` field. The receipt could carry it for kitchen+bag but the cart has no place to type it.
gaps.fix_sketch: Add `orders.customer_message` varchar(160) + an optional input under customer selector ('Message client / anniversaire / etc.') visible to KDS + printed on bag receipt.

gaps.title: No 'pause cuisine' signal from chef visible at caisse
gaps.chef_question: Chef demande 5 min de pause pour rattraper rush. Caissier devrait STOP de prendre commandes hot/grill.
gaps.evidence: PosComponent.vue:51-71 banner is for AVAILABILITY (rupture stock). No banner/toast for 'cuisine en sur-charge'. No category-level pause (e.g. 'pause grillades 5 min'). KDS-side pause-cuisine event would need to be added.
gaps.fix_sketch: Backend pause-cuisine endpoint (chef PIN required) emits broadcast; POS adds banner 'Cuisine: pause grillades 5 min — proposer d'autres catégories' and visually dims affected category pills.

top_3_priority.why: OrderItem.instruction column EXISTS, KDS displays it (per kiosk cash panel echo) — but POS direct-sale cart has NO setter UI. Zero-risk additive fix, immediate chef value, schema already in place. The lowest-cost, highest-value gap.

Allergen capture is a regulatory + safety surface. Kiosk handles it (allergens_snapshot displayed) but POS direct-sale has no path to record an allergen observed at counter. Single new column + simple chip UI.

Livraison surface is the most under-served in POS today. Order-type radio includes 'Livraison' with address but ZERO livreur coordination. In a rush this becomes a phone-call mess. DeliveryBoyCashSession data already exists — UI strip is a low-risk wire-up.

verdict.summary: POS V1 is well-engineered for cash handling, idempotency and NF525 fiscal flow, but it treats the caisse as a payment terminal rather than a chef-coordination hub. 10 gaps identified, 4 P1 (direct chef impact) + 5 P2 (UX/operational comfort) + 1 P1 marked as recall surface. The schema layer (Order, OrderItem) already supports per-line instructions — only the cart UI is missing. Allergen capture and livreur coordination are the next two zero-frozen-zone wins.
verdict.scope_summary: 10 gaps across 4 axes : kitchen-instruction (3), urgency/priority (2), stock+pause coordination (2), livreur+lock+message (3)
verdict.frozen_zone_safety: All 10 fixes can be designed scope-minimal: NONE require touching PaymentComponent.vue, PosV5TrancheRow.vue, pos-wizard.js, FiscalSequenceService, ZReportService, or AuditLogService.
verdict.v1_v1_0_2_split_recommendation: G-POS-CHEF-01 (cart instruction input) + G-POS-CHEF-03 (allergen chip) shippable as V1.0.1 quick-wins. G-POS-CHEF-02 (priority) + G-POS-CHEF-05 (livreur strip) + G-POS-CHEF-08 (recall) deserve V1.0.2 with broader KDS coordination plan.
